notes.title: 🛰️ New Enemy in the Skies: ICU666 Now Live!
notes.content:
A new threat patrols the night — and it sees everything.
Meet the ICU666, a high-speed aerial scout bot sent to keep tabs on your every move.

But now? You can fight back.

🧠 New flying enemy: ICU666

✂️ Slice through it mid-air for an explosive finish

💥 Death FX, divebombs, and smoke trails

⚠️ Watch for the fall zone — if you’re too close when it hits the ground, it might just take you with it…

We’ve been tweaking a ton under the hood and there’s more on the way — but we couldn’t sit on this bot any longer.

You wanted more to kill. We delivered.

💀 Update now and let it burn.

notes.title: 🚨 DEMO UPDATE DEPLOYED: NITELIFE EXPANSION 🚨
notes.content:
You said it was too short.
You were right.

So over the weekend, I built a new zone: NITELIFE
A city that lives, breathes, and pulses with grime and neon.
Stripz breaks through it. And the city? It’s got secrets.


💥 New buildings
💥 New systems
💥 New polish
💥 Clean hierarchy (don’t sleep on it)
💥 Better flow, more gameplay

This isn’t a patch. This is proof:
I’m not done.

I built all of it alone. Art, code, animation. and I’m not slowing down.
Updates will drop daily. New content. New story beats. New motion.

I broke Adobe Animate getting here.
I need Toon Boom now just to keep going.
If you want to support this fight:
🛠️ https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/FQQW9QNHBDBZL

I don’t want pity. I want power.
Let’s glitch the system.

This isn’t just about fun.
It’s about building something real.
Something that moves. Something that means something.

I don’t just take feedback.
I weaponize (and appreciate) it.

Stripz cuts through systems.
So do I.

The glitch is live. NiteLife is breathing.

More is on the way.

notes.title: NEW BUILD WENT LIVE 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]The updated demo has been launched. [/h1]

[h3]What used to be a 10-minute chaos ride, then a 5-minute storm, is now a 1-minute vertical slice—tight, polished, and packed with everything I’ve got.

I crammed as much soul and satire as I could into 60 seconds because I thought that’s what I had to do to be seen.

But it turns out... people felt it.
And now, it’s time to give it more.

I’ll be planning an expansion of the vertical slice—building more of the world, deepening the journey, and letting Stripz show even more of what’s beneath the surface.

I’m not making this game for trends.
I’m making it to survive.
And if it resonates with you—
I’m glad you’re here.[/h3]

[h2]Stay tuned. This rebellion’s just getting started.[/h2]
